name: Will a deck drainage system affect my deck's appearance?

mainEntity.name: Will a deck drainage system affect my deck's appearance?

acceptedAnswer.text: The impact on your deck's appearance depends on the system chosen. Over-joist systems are virtually invisible from above, as they are installed beneath the decking. Under-joist systems are visible from underneath the deck and can be designed to enhance the aesthetics of the lower space. Some under-joist systems offer a clean, finished ceiling look, often in various colors, while others are more utilitarian. When considering options, evaluate whether you want the under-deck area to be a finished living space, as this will influence the aesthetic considerations and available choices.
acceptedAnswer.description: Over-joist systems are hidden, while under-joist systems are visible from below and can offer a finished ceiling look, impacting the lower space's aesthetic.
